BiblicalUsage: The word means increase, the produce of the land. Israel was to tithe all the increase of the seed that the field brought forth year by year; Joseph told Egypt to give Pharaoh a fifth of the increase, and four parts should be for the seed of the field; and the feast of ingathering was kept when the fruit of the land had been gathered in.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the increase belongs to God first, and the tithe is the sign that the field is His.
